title: Search prompt history in the Claude pane, across sessions
notes: Claude Code: Ctrl+R reverse search; history kept across sessions. Pane: Up/Down walk only this transcript's prompts (chat-view.ts:341). No SDK need. Size S.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #108: Ctrl+R searches every prompt sent in the project's 20 most recent conversations and puts the picked one in the box. Version 2.14.0.
